idea: 分档非线性增强：将修正强度按五分位分桶(bucket)，对前20%强烈上修给予+40%多头放大，对后20%下修给予-30%空头缩减(中间段零调整)，配合signed_power对核心效率因子进行1.5次幂拉伸以强化头尾区分度，形成非线性的双边增强结构。
expression_list: multiply(signed_power(group_zscore(winsorize(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), industry), 1.5), add(1, if_else(greater(bucket(rank(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5)), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.8), 0.4, if_else(less(bucket(rank(ts_delta(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5)), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.2), -0.3, 0))))

multiply(signed_power(group_zscore(winsorize(divide(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), std=4), industry), 1.5), add(1, if_else(greater(bucket(rank(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5)), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.8), 0.4, if_else(less(bucket(rank(ts_delta(anl69_aeps_best_eeps_cur_yr, 5)), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.2), -0.3, 0))))
